completion_criteria: All approved source searches reached their stopping rule or have a disclosed incomplete status.
All deduplication candidates, screening conflicts, unavailable full texts, and extraction conflicts have an owner disposition.
Every synthesis claim links to validated extractions and preserves conflicting or uncertain evidence.
PRISMA counts reconcile with the immutable search, deduplication, and screening records.

edge_cases: A conceptual framework mentions agents but defines no executable or mathematical dynamics.
A social-media study measures polarization without modeling opinion change.
examples: A purely qualitative essay about public opinion.
eligibility_criteria.statement: Exclude work that neither defines, analyzes, implements, nor empirically evaluates a computational or mathematical model of opinion or belief dynamics.

edge_cases: A non-archival extended abstract is linked to a later full paper.
A preprint is the only accessible manifestation of an otherwise eligible work.
examples: A blog post describing a simulation without a scholarly manuscript.
eligibility_criteria.statement: Exclude editorials, news, slides, calls for papers, and other non-scholarly products; retain eligible preprints only as manifestations of a scholarly work.

edge_cases: A generic consensus model reports both engineering and human-opinion experiments.
An LLM-agent study explicitly models human-like belief or opinion change.
examples: A robot-control consensus protocol with no social interpretation.
eligibility_criteria.statement: Exclude consensus, diffusion, or contagion studies that have no explicit interpretation or evaluation involving human opinions, beliefs, attitudes, or social influence.

edge_cases: An English abstract accompanies a full text in another language.
Online-first and issue publication years differ.
examples: A publication outside the registered date interval.
eligibility_criteria.statement: Exclude works outside the registered publication interval or without an English full-text manifestation available for screening.

edge_cases: Belief, attitude, polarization, consensus, or social-influence terminology is used instead of the phrase opinion dynamics.
The opinion model is one component of a larger information-diffusion system.
examples: A bounded-confidence agent-based model with specified update rules.
A voter-model analysis interpreted as social opinion formation.
eligibility_criteria.statement: Include scholarly work that defines, analyzes, implements, compares, calibrates, or validates computational or mathematical dynamics of human opinions, beliefs, attitudes, polarization, consensus, or social influence.

edge_cases: A benchmark paper contributes validation data but no new model.
A secondary study is mapped for snowballing but is not counted as a primary study.
examples: An analytical treatment, simulation study, or empirical calibration of an opinion model.
eligibility_criteria.statement: Include analytical, simulation, or empirical studies that provide inspectable methods or evidence relevant to the registered mapping questions.

extraction_fields.description: Empirical datasets, calibration targets, or observed social systems used by the work.
Explicit limitations, unresolved anomalies, and future-work gaps stated by the authors.
Opinion-dynamics model family or families studied, including named classical and LLM-agent variants.
Network, spatial, complete-graph, platform-derived, or other interaction structures.
Availability and identity of code, data, parameters, seeds, environment, and executable reproduction artifacts.
Analytical, numerical, empirical, sensitivity, robustness, or external validation performed.

information_sources.authority_scope: Complementary discovery of scholarly preprint manifestations in the official arXiv index.
limitations: Preprint and published manifestations may lack a shared DOI and require identifier reconciliation or human adjudication.
Search all-fields covers arXiv metadata, not article full text; sources overlap with OpenAlex.
The adapter does not apply a publication-date filter; eligibility must inspect the retained original publication date, never infer a day from a year.
information_sources.name: arXiv Atom API

information_sources.authority_scope: Exact DOI metadata recovery for recorded reference edges, coverage-challenge candidates and the two missing-title observations; not free-text multidisciplinary discovery or eligibility evidence.
limitations: Abstracts, references, keywords, and other fields depend on member deposits.
Coverage and metadata quality vary by publisher and discipline.
Crossref alone is not sufficient evidence of multidisciplinary review coverage.
information_sources.name: Crossref REST API

information_sources.authority_scope: Complementary computer-science title discovery over the official DBLP graph.
limitations: DBLP has no abstracts; registered terms are OR-combined case-insensitive title substrings, not translations of OpenAlex Boolean ranking.
The legacy dblp.org publication search currently serves an anti-bot challenge; its historical raw pages remain replayable.
The live graph changes; a deterministic ordering and repeated count do not establish snapshot isolation.
information_sources.name: DBLP knowledge graph SPARQL

information_sources.authority_scope: Primary multidisciplinary discovery through explicitly scoped title and abstract searches; query-design membership is separate from acquisition and screening calibration.
limitations: Coverage expansion can introduce repository manifestations and additional screening noise.
Metadata and indexed abstracts can change as the live index is updated.
OpenAlex does not apply the review protocol's scientific quality threshold.
OpenAlex ingests arXiv and other sources, so overlaps are expected and sources are not statistically independent.
Titles and indexed abstracts may be missing or incomplete; registered citation chasing and complementary sources address coverage gaps.
information_sources.name: OpenAlex Works API

objectives: Identify evidence gaps that can justify a focused, testable IC contribution without asserting novelty from absence alone.
Map computational opinion-dynamics model families, assumptions, interaction structures, empirical grounding, and reported outcomes.
Map validation, robustness, sensitivity, reproducibility, and code or data availability practices.

operational_definitions.definition: Any explicit use of observed data, measured networks, surveys, experiments, platform traces, or empirical targets to specify, calibrate, compare, or validate a model.
A mathematical or computational process in which human opinions, beliefs, attitudes, polarization, consensus, or social influence change through time or interaction.
Evidence that another researcher can identify the implementation, inputs, parameters, seeds, environment, and steps needed to regenerate reported results.
A check that model structure, implementation, calibration, predictions, sensitivity, or conclusions are adequate for the stated scientific claim.

quality_criteria.question: Are calibration targets, empirical comparisons, and their limitations reported well enough to evaluate the claimed real-world validity?
Are states, parameters, interaction rules, topology, initial conditions, and outcome definitions specified well enough to assess the model?
Are code, data, parameters, seeds, environment, and execution instructions available or reported sufficiently for independent reproduction?
Are sensitivity, uncertainty, alternative assumptions, stochastic variability, or out-of-sample behavior assessed in proportion to the claims?

review_questions.question: Which model families, state representations, update rules, and interaction topologies are used in computational opinion dynamics?
How are computational opinion-dynamics models specified, calibrated, validated, stress-tested, and compared with analytical or empirical evidence?
Which code, data, parameter, seed, environment, and reporting artifacts are available for reproduction?
Which limitations, conflicting findings, and under-tested assumptions remain after stratifying by model family, topology, and evidence type?

supplementary_search_policy.stopping_rule: Run two consecutive citation-chasing rounds with no new eligible work after deduplication. Keep seeds, citation edges, exact queries, dates and source records. The registered Crossref DOI-filter strategies recover known references only, with at most two 20-record pages per DOI (one matching page and one empty cursor confirmation). No unfiltered Crossref discovery. References without a verified identifier remain in a reconciliation ledger. Davi performs controlled ACM/IEEE exports and supplies real reference judgments. Unresolved access or identity remains pending; secondary seeds never automatically become primary inclusions.

protocol.title: Systematic map of computational opinion-dynamics models, validation, and reproducibility
